Passage: An organisation estimates the size of a new payroll system at 32 KLOC and classifies it as an organic project. It uses Basic COCOMO, with Effort E = 2.4 (KLOC)^1.05 person-months and Development time D = 2.5 (E)^0.38 months. The average cost of one person-month is ₹1,20,000.

What is the estimated development time D?
explanation: पहले E ≈ 91.3 PM, फिर D = 2.5 × 91.3^0.38 ≈ 13.9 माह। जाल: semi-detached का घातांक 0.35 लेने पर 12.1, और E की जगह KLOC (32) रख देने पर 2.5 × 32^0.38 ≈ 9.3।

question:

Passage: A company makes two products P and Q. Each unit of P needs 1 hour of machining and 3 hours of assembly; each unit of Q needs 2 hours of machining and 2 hours of assembly. At most 8 machining hours and 12 assembly hours are available. The profit is ₹3 per unit of P and ₹4 per unit of Q. Let x and y be the numbers of units of P and Q produced.

With dual variables u (machining) and v (assembly), the dual of this LPP is —
options: Minimize W = 8u + 12v subject to u + 3v ≥ 3, 2u + 2v ≥ 4, u, v ≥ 0
Minimize W = 3u + 4v subject to u + 2v ≥ 8, 3u + 2v ≥ 12, u, v ≥ 0
Maximize W = 8u + 12v subject to u + 3v ≤ 3, 2u + 2v ≤ 4, u, v ≥ 0
Minimize W = 8u + 12v subject to u + 2v ≥ 3, 3u + 2v ≥ 4, u, v ≥ 0
explanation: मूल (max, ≤) का दुहरा (min, ≥) होता है: उद्देश्य में दाहिने पक्ष (8, 12), और बाधाएँ गुणांक-आव्यूह के ट्रांसपोज़ से — x का स्तंभ (1, 3) → u + 3v ≥ 3; y का स्तंभ (2, 2) → 2u + 2v ≥ 4। अंतिम विकल्प ट्रांसपोज़ भूल जाने की भूल है।

question:
Which of the following are tautologies?
A. (p → q) ↔ (¬q → ¬p)
B. (p ∧ (p → q)) → q
C. (p → q) → (q → p)
D. ¬(p ∨ q) ↔ (¬p ∧ ¬q)
E. (p ∨ q) → p
Choose the correct answer from the options given below:
explanation: A प्रतिधनात्मक (contrapositive) तुल्यता है, B मोडस पोनेन्स, D डी-मॉर्गन का नियम — तीनों सदा सत्य। C में p असत्य और q सत्य लें तो (T) → (F) = F। E में p = F, q = T पर F। अतः A, B, D।

D. Disjunctive syllogism
LIST-II (Form)

question:
Match LIST-I with LIST-II:
LIST-I (I/O technique)
A. Programmed I/O
B. Interrupt-driven I/O
C. DMA (cycle stealing)
D. I/O processor
LIST-II (Characteristic)
I. The CPU does other work while the device gets ready; on an interrupt, the CPU itself transfers the data
II. A separate processor executes its own channel programs and manages several devices
III. The CPU repeatedly tests the device's status flag (busy waiting)
IV. The controller takes the bus one word at a time and moves data directly between the device and memory
Choose the correct answer from the options given below:
explanation: प्रोग्राम्ड I/O में CPU बार-बार फ़्लैग जाँचता है (समय बर्बाद)। इंटरप्ट-ड्रिवन में प्रतीक्षा बचती है पर डेटा फिर भी CPU ही भेजता है। DMA में कंट्रोलर सीधे मेमोरी से डेटा ले-जाता है। IOP/चैनल अपने प्रोग्राम चलाकर कई उपकरण सँभालता है।

right: I. The CPU does other work while the device gets ready; on an interrupt, the CPU itself transfers the data
II. A separate processor executes its own channel programs and manages several devices
III. The CPU repeatedly tests the device's status flag (busy waiting)
IV. The controller takes the bus one word at a time and moves data directly between the device and memory

question: A cache has an access time of 2 ns and a hit ratio of 0.9; main memory has an access time of 50 ns. On a miss, the cache is checked first and then main memory is accessed. The average memory access time is —

Which of the following statements are correct?
A. The Z-buffer (depth-buffer) algorithm is an image-space method.
B. The painter's algorithm is also called the depth-sort algorithm.
C. Gouraud shading interpolates intensity values across a polygon.
D. Phong shading interpolates surface normal vectors across a polygon.
E. Back-face detection alone removes all hidden surfaces in any scene.
Choose the correct answer from the options given below:
options: A, B, C and D only
B, C, D and E only
explanation: Z-बफ़र हर पिक्सेल की गहराई तुलना करता है (image space); पेंटर दूर से पास की ओर रँगता है (depth sort); गौरॉड तीव्रता का, फ़ोंग नॉर्मल का अंतर्वेशन करता है (स्पेक्युलर हाइलाइट बेहतर)। बैक-फ़ेस हटाना केवल उत्तल वस्तुओं के लिए पर्याप्त है — एक वस्तु दूसरी को ढके तो नहीं।

subject: computer
question: In the life cycle of a Java servlet, which method is called only once, when the servlet is first loaded by the container?
explanation: कंटेनर सर्वलेट लोड करते ही एक बार init() चलाता है; फिर हर अनुरोध पर service() (जो doGet/doPost बुलाता है); अनलोड होने पर एक बार destroy()। इसीलिए DB-कनेक्शन जैसी एक-बारी तैयारी init() में रखी जाती है।
